source: docs/v1-spec.md, Zoning rules engine; numbers checked against the Chicago Zoning Ordinance text on 2026-10-30

steps.rule: floor(lot_area / lot_area_per_unit); a lot below the district's minimum lot area gets no by-right units beyond one detached house

RS-3: lot area per unit drops to 1,500 sq ft, for a two-unit building only, when 60% or more of the lots on the same side of the street between the two nearest cross streets hold buildings with more than one unit, or when the lot is in the Predominance of the Block (606) District
steps.data: block faces from parcel addresses (street, side, hundred block) and units per lot from Assessor classes and x54s-btds apartments; the hundred block stands in for 'between the two nearest cross streets'

steps.rule: lot area per unit may be reduced by up to 10%: units = floor(lot_area / (0.9 * lot_area_per_unit)); height +10%
steps.approval: administrative adjustment from the Zoning Administrator

steps.rule: +1 unit (coach house or conversion unit) in RT-4, RM and B/C districts; in RS and RT-3.5 only inside the city's ADU zones. 2+ ADUs trigger the affordability rule
steps.section: ADU ordinance, permanent citywide 2026-04-01; ADU zones layer

steps.rule: recompute at a target district the user picks; default is the first target listed. B/C targets keep the lot's letter family (B3-1 to B3-2)
car parking 1 space per unit outside transit-served locations; 0 inside them, with bike parking 1 per unit
B3-3 and C3-3 lots in a transit-served location may use lower lot area per unit and higher FAR with on-site affordable units under the ARO
an all-residential building in a B or C district needs ground-floor dwelling units: by right in B2, special use in B1, B3, C1 and C2, not allowed in C3
steps.section: 17-3-0207 (use table: dwelling units below the second floor)

steps.rule: flag the Affordable Requirements Ordinance when a rezoning scenario reaches 10+ units

historic orange/red rating (90-day demolition hold), landmark, 606/Pilsen demolition surcharge and district rules (data/rules/special_districts.json), fire limits (wood frame restricted), split-zoned lot, lot size from the Assessor instead of a polygon

not_in_v1: D, M, PMD, PD, POS and T districts (results say the district is not covered)
